mainEntity.name: Can AI help me create a digital product people will actually buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can help draft a digital product, but it does not validate demand, guarantee originality, or make the finished product valuable. The owner still needs to define the audience, evaluate the problem, review the material, and decide what should be published.

A practical product workflow may combine opportunity research, course outlining, lesson scripting, presentation development, video support, and launch preparation. Each stage should have a review point so errors do not pass directly into the final offer.

Key factors:
- Evidence of audience interest
- Accuracy and usefulness of content
- Distinctive experience or expertise
- Delivery and customer-support requirements

Create a small pilot or sample before producing a large catalog. Run My AI Business’s course-building examples are educational starting points, not proof that every AI-created product will sell.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can accelerate research, outlines, lessons, presentations, videos, and launch materials, but it cannot guarantee demand or sales. Validate the audience problem, review every deliverable, and test a small version before investing heavily.
